as_told.title: 1943 reverse engineering of a German pulse jet

plain: In 1943, engineers at Wright Field, an American military airfield, are said to have successfully reverse engineered a German pulse jet engine. That means they took apart an enemy engine to work out how to build one themselves. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether Oppenheimer worked on UFOs. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says the same thing on a later episode, also without giving a source. If true, it would mean the base already knew how to copy technology it had not invented.
